spec.description:
ProctorPassive DriFlash Tape is a high performance single-sided
vapor-permeable fleece tape coated with a solvent-free acrylic adhesive,
protected by a split release paper. It is designed to provide water, air, and
weather-tight seals around wall and roof penetration interfaces, including
window and door openings. Because it is vapor permeable, it allows moisture
within wall framing junctions to dry out safely while blocking external wind and
liquid water.
features:
Vapour permeable fleece carrier allowing trapped
moisture to dry outward

Solvent-free polyacrylic pressure-sensitive adhesive
with high initial tack

Split release backing paper for fast and accurate
corner application

Creates an airtight and weathertight seal around
penetrations and joints

High UV resistance suitable for installation before
cladding is completed

Bonds aggressively to timber, metal, rigid insulation,
and building wraps

Flexible fleece backing accommodates building movement and
thermal expansion
Suitable for internal and external envelope air sealing

technical.value: 75 mm x 25 m, 100 mm x 25 m, 150 mm x 25 m

spec.fire: Reaction to fire Class E to EN 13501-1
spec.compliance:
AS/NZS 4200.2:2017, NCC 2022 Volume One & Two condensation
management, Passive House air barrier requirements
spec.sustainability: Solvent-free, zero chlorine, zero formaldehyde, low VOC emissions
install:
Ensure substrate is dry, clean, dust-free, and free of oil, grease, or loose
particles

Measure and cut tape to required length allowing for overlaps at
corners
Peel back the first section of the split release liner paper
Position tape evenly across the window jamb, sill, or penetration junction

Remove the remaining split release liner while smoothing the tape onto the
adjacent surface

Press firmly along the entire tape length using a hand
roller or squeegee to achieve 100% adhesion

Ensure corner joins overlap by a
minimum of 50mm

Apply in dry weather within the temperature range of -10°C to
+40°C
selection_checklist:
Confirm width needed (75mm for flat
seams, 100mm/150mm for window sills and rough openings)

Verify need for
vapour-permeable flashing to avoid trapping moisture in structural framing

Ensure substrate is compatible (timber, steel, concrete, OSB, or pliable
membranes)

Check compatibility with air-barrier and water-resistive barrier
membranes
limitations:
Do not apply over wet, frozen, or
heavily contaminated surfaces

Pressure-sensitive adhesive requires firm
rolling for complete mechanical bond

Must not be permanently exposed to UV
weather beyond manufacturer limits
spec.warranty:
Backed by Proctor Group
Australia product warranty

problem_keywords: air leaks at window frame junctions
failing blower door test around doors
use_cases:
Sealing window and door framing
junctions to external vapour-permeable wall wraps

Air and weathertight
sealing of pipe, duct, and cable penetrations through building envelopes
Joining roof underlay sheets at hips, valleys, and ridge interfaces
retrieval.rag_summary:
ProctorPassive DriFlash Tape is a high-performance, single-sided
vapour-permeable fleece flashing tape coated with solvent-free polyacrylic
adhesive. Designed with a split release liner, it seals window and door frames,
penetrations, and wall-to-roof junctions to provide continuous airtight and
weathertight protection. Its vapour-permeable fleece core (Sd 0.03m) allows
trapped moisture inside framing to dry outward, mitigating rot and mould while
supporting Passive House airtightness standards.
